children: Associated Banc's Randall J. Erickson will retire as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary effective October 13, 2026, and will serve as Attorney-Advisor through January 4, 2027.
Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary; Attorney-Advisor (post-retirement)
Retirement effective October 13, 2026; Attorney-Advisor role from October 13, 2026 to January 4, 2027

Will report to CEO; will have duties, authority and responsibility as determined by CEO and General Counsel and Corporate Secretary; will maintain base salary, retain vested plan rights, eligible for 2026 short-term incentive, and continue vesting in specified LTIPP awards per filing
